functions.name: User ID
functions.description: This function retrieves user identification details, including their affiliation and contact information.

outputParameters.name: actualizationDate
outputParameters.description: The date when the user's information was last updated.

outputParameters.name: affiliationChannel
outputParameters.description: The channel through which the user was affiliated or registered.

outputParameters.name: affiliationDate
outputParameters.description: The date when the user was initially affiliated or registered.

outputParameters.name: cardNumber
outputParameters.description: The user's card number associated with their account.

outputParameters.name: operatorCode
outputParameters.description: The code representing the operator handling the user's account.

outputParameters.name: uniqueCode
outputParameters.description: A unique code identifying the user within the system.
